newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells Bombay low aromatic naphtha to Itochu.
newsitem.headline: India sells Bombay low aromatic naphtha to Itochu.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has sold by tender 20,000-tonnes of low aromatic naphtha (LAN) to Japanese trading house Itochu, a company source confirmed on Friday.
The source declined to reveal the winning price but industry sources said it was at a discount of $22.50 a tonne to spot Japanese quotes, on a free-on-board basis.
The cargo is to be lifted from Bombay on January 6-8.
In its last LAN tender from Bombay, IOC sold 25,000-tonnes for December 10-12 lifting at $17.35 per tonne below Japanese spot quotes, fob basis, to Dutch trader Vitol.
